title: Saudi-Iran War Risk Grows as Riyadh Resumes Yemen Bombing
detail: Analysts warn the Saudi-Iran conflict is no longer a contained proxy war as Riyadh resumes active Yemen bombing operations. The escalation raises fears of direct confrontation between the two regional powers, with Saudi Arabia's renewed airstrikes on Houthi positions seen as a signal of increased willingness to confront Iranian proxies directly.

title: Saudi-Led Coalition Strikes Hodeidah, Sanaa, Saada as Yemen Government Offensive Begins
detail: The coalition said naval forces destroyed weapons depots, explosive-boat facilities and naval mines in Hodeidah, a ballistic missile launch platform in Sanaa and a storage site holding 20 missiles in Saada. Yemen's government launched Operation Dawn of Yemen to retake Houthi-held territory with Saudi air support; the Houthis claimed to have repelled advances in Dhubab and Bab Al Mandab. Bahrain backed Riyadh's support for the government. Claims are unverified.
